Package com.miniandmore.app.service

Class ZohoBooksItemAttributes

java.lang.Object
com.miniandmore.app.service.ZohoBooksItemAttributes
public final class ZohoBooksItemAttributes extends Object
Reads Zoho Books / Inventory item fields for simple items vs grouped variants.

Zoho Books has no parent SKU. Each sellable SKU is its own item_id. When the Inventory add-on is enabled, related variants share group_id / group_name and expose attribute_name1..3 + attribute_option_name1..3 (typically Size and Color).

    • parentDisplayName

      public static String parentDisplayName(Map<String,Object> item)
      Parent title for admin/storefront. Zoho sometimes stores the full variant label as group_name (e.g. Book Style Tying Jabla — 0-3 M / Aqua) when each size×print is its own singleton group — strip that suffix so siblings still merge under one parent.
